title: Milk and dairy consumption and incidence of cardiovascular diseases and all-cause mortality: dose-response meta-analysis of prospective cohort studies
authors: Soedamah-Muthu SS, Ding EL, Al-Delaimy WK, Hu FB, Engberink MF, Willett WC, et al.
population: 17 prospective cohort studies; searches to February 2010
funder: Supported by an unrestricted grant from the Dutch Dairy Association (to SSS-M and JMG). The Dutch Dairy Association (Nederlandse Zuivelorganisatie, nzo.nl) is the trade association of Dutch dairy processing companies.
result: Per 200 mL/day milk: overall cardiovascular disease RR 0.94 (95% CI 0.89 to 0.99; 4 studies); coronary heart disease 1.00 (0.96 to 1.04; 6 studies); stroke 0.87 (0.72 to 1.05; 6 studies); total mortality 0.99 (0.95 to 1.03; 8 studies).
